packages.description: Fake processor package used to prove UpStream processor handoff.
Minimal DeepStream/GStreamer RTSP decode probe package.
DeepStream 8.0 nvinfer sample-model (TrafficCamNet) inference probe. RTSP decode + nvinfer; detection evidence is status/log-only (KITTI dump). No observations, no metadata extraction, no pyds.

DeepStream 8.0 + pyds metadata probe. Runs a pyds pad probe in a DS 8.0 + pyds container, walks NvDsBatchMeta/NvDsFrameMeta/NvDsObjectMeta, and surfaces neutral per-frame metadata through the BoundedBridgeQueue/MetadataSource seam into the worker's status payload (counters + class_counts + queue_stats). Status/debug evidence only -- no observations, no metadata adapter, no API writes.

DeepStream 8.0 + pyds metadata probe with nvtracker enabled. Same pyds pad probe as deepstream.metadata_probe.v0, but inserts an nvtracker element (IOU low-level config by default) after nvinfer so NvDsObjectMeta.object_id is a real stable tracker id across frames. The pad probe runs on the tracker src pad. Status payload adds tracker_enabled, has_tracker_id, unique_tracker_ids_count, and a bounded tracker_ids_sample. Still status/debug evidence only -- no observations, no metadata adapter, no API writes.

DeepStream 8.0 + pyds metadata probe with nvtracker AND nvdsanalytics enabled (TrafficCamNet sample detector). Same pyds pad probe as deepstream.tracker_probe.v0 but inserts an nvdsanalytics element after nvtracker; the pad probe walks NvDsUserMeta on frames (NvDsAnalyticsFrameMeta: objInROIcnt / objLCCumCnt / objLCCurrCnt / ocStatus) and objects (NvDsAnalyticsObjInfo: roiStatus / lcStatus / dirStatus / ocStatus). Geometry is the operator-saved dashboard geometry when present (P6-C), else the probe-default central ROI + midline. With an ObservationWriter wired (P4-B..P4-E) this mode EMITS the line/ROI/zone/dwell observation types listed in outputs; known limitation: TrafficCamNet misclassifies people in non-traffic scenes (P4-D), which is what the YOLOX analytics package exists to fix.

DeepStream 8.0 + pyds metadata probe running YOLOX-S (COCO-80) instead of the TrafficCamNet sample model. Same pyds pad probe / BoundedBridgeQueue seam as deepstream.metadata_probe.v0; the PGIE config is the registry-driven YOLOX plan (raw official ONNX + custom grid-decode bbox parser, FP16 engine cached in the host model store). Requires operator-prepared artifacts (scripts/prepare_yolox_model.sh). Status/debug evidence only -- no observations, no metadata adapter, no API writes. No tracker, no analytics.

People-analytics probe: YOLOX-S (COCO-80, P5-B live-verified person detection) through the existing IOU tracker + nvdsanalytics chain. Same analytics worker path as deepstream.analytics_probe.v0 — operator-saved dashboard geometry with probe-default fallback, pyds metadata, and the existing line/ROI/zone/dwell observation adapters — with the detector swapped to fix TrafficCamNet's person misclassification (P4-D). Requires operator-prepared YOLOX artifacts (scripts/prepare_yolox_model.sh). Live status (P5-D, 2026-06-11): zone_entered / roi_occupancy / dwell_started / dwell_updated / dwell_exceeded verified live with person-scoped, bounded volume; zone_exited / line_crossing / line_crossing_object NOT yet observed live — analysis points at IOU track fragmentation during walking motion (detector strong, adapter paths unit-proven). Tracker profile expansion is the recommended fix. Internal probe only; not customer-facing.

packages.display_name: People Analytics — YOLOX + NvDCF Probe v0
packages.description: People-analytics probe variant of deepstream.yolox_analytics_probe.v0 with the IOU tracker swapped for the NvDCF tracker profile (deepstream_nvdcf_balanced_v1). Same YOLOX-S (COCO-80) detector + nvdsanalytics chain and the same line/ROI/zone/dwell observation adapters — only the tracker changes. Exists for the P5-E IOU-vs-NvDCF A/B comparison: NvDCF visual correlation tracking is expected to reduce track-ID fragmentation during walking motion, which P5-D analysis flagged as the cause of the unproven zone_exited / line_crossing / line_crossing_object events. EXPERIMENTAL: the NvDCF ll-config is authored but NOT yet live-verified on the Blackwell/DS8 GPU host — do not treat as probe-grade until the live A/B passes (see docs/local-dev.md P5-E runbook). Requires operator-prepared YOLOX artifacts (scripts/prepare_yolox_model.sh). Internal probe only; not customer-facing.
